name: model-balance
description: Routes each prompt to the main conversation or to a Haiku, Sonnet or Opus worker subagent by its difficulty, whatever the main model is, each worker at its own effort and never at max. Main briefs each worker, follow-ups continue the last worker, and a board shows the running subagents with the finished ones behind a button. Switched on and off per session.

router_model.title: Router model
router_model.description: Model that rates each prompt before routing it. Sonnet judges follow-ups and questions the main conversation can answer more reliably; Haiku answers faster. The other one stands in when it fails.

haiku_effort.title: Haiku worker effort
haiku_effort.description: Effort the Haiku worker runs at, set as its agent definition's effort. 'session' sets none and leaves it to Claude Code's own resolution. Subagents never run at max.

sonnet_effort.title: Sonnet worker effort
sonnet_effort.description: Effort the Sonnet worker runs at, set as its agent definition's effort. 'session' sets none and leaves it to Claude Code's own resolution. Subagents never run at max.
